visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a black and white plaid shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor hallway. She looks directly at the camera and speaks with expressive facial movements. (2) Cut to a shot of a different person in a white t-shirt leaning over several stacked brown cardboard boxes labeled 'BOOKS' with a black marker. (3) The first woman reappears, holding a round silver metallic device with a suction lever. A colorful animated owl graphic with heart eyes and wings flapping appears in the bottom center. (4) Close-up of the woman's hands holding the silver device. She points at its features while speaking. (5) A black wire storage basket is shown being held against a white bathroom sink surface. Two large suction cups are visible on the back of the basket. (6) Back to the woman in the plaid shirt; she holds the silver device close to her face, smiling. (7) Close-up demonstration of a hand pressing down a black rubber suction base onto a flat surface and then flipping a silver lever to secure it. (8) The hand pulls a small plastic tab on the edge of the suction cup to release the vacuum, and the device is removed easily. (9) Montage of the device in use: a silver rack with multiple hooks is attached to the back of a white door, holding several shirts. A hand pulls one shirt off. (10) The white door is closed, showing how the storage is hidden behind it. (11) A white plastic storage bin is attached to the side of a white cabinet using the suction device. (12) A hand places baby bottles and a small yellow spray bottle into the white bin. A towel is hung on a nearby hook. (13) Close-up of the hook being detached from the cabinet, showing no residue or damage. (14) In a bathroom, a triangular wire corner shelf is attached to grey wall tiles, holding two large green pump bottles. (15) In a shower area, a rectangular wire basket is attached to white tiles, holding several yellow and green bottles. A hand presses down on the basket to show its stability. (16) A white soap dish shaped like a blooming rose is shown. A hand places a white bar of soap into it and then lifts the inner tray to demonstrate easy cleaning. (17) The woman in the plaid shirt continues her presentation, holding the silver suction device and gesturing with her free hand. (18) A series of still images shows different compatible surfaces: marble-textured tiles, large glass windows of a high-rise building, and a hand attaching a small orange plate to a smooth wall. (19) A series of still images shows incompatible surfaces: rough unpainted wood planks, a person painting a grey cement wall with a roller, and a close-up of unglazed terracotta-colored tiles. (20) Final shot of the woman in the plaid shirt pointing both index fingers upward. Large pink and white text overlays the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem -> Solution Introduction -> Feature Demonstration -> Use Case Scenarios -> Limitation Warning -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional endorsement for FECA suction cup storage products. It aims to solve the consumer pain point of messy home storage and damaging walls with nails or glue. By demonstrating the product's high suction power, versatility in different rooms (kitchen, bathroom, closet), and ease of cleaning, it persuades the viewer to participate in a current 'group buy' offer.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker mentions the brand name 'FECA' multiple times, demonstrates its specific usage, lists promotional benefits, and explicitly states 'now in group buy' (現在團購中) with a text overlay.
